positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a tool to data mine the IBM DOORS database using DXL and Python
- Wrote a DXL script to parse table attributes and verify data references corresponding to the correct data definition table
- Parsed information on linkage between modules and data items within the module tables
- Designed the application GUI for ease of navigation and data representation using Python

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed software verification tool for the Certifiable Predator B program
- Assessed software FAA certification process according to the D0-178 standard
- Used C and Python to create a tool to check for software compliance with coding standards
- Reduced the time and cost to verify code with company coding standards

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented design of engine software configuration tool for the RS-25 rocket engine using C# and JavaScript in Visual Studio
- Designed and implemented a GUI and storyboard for ease of use and functionality
- Developed back-end code to populate GUI with data from Microsoft SQL Server
- Assisted in database design and presented change proposals to team and customer

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a web-based time-tracking application using Java, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript
- Developed the core function and modules of the application

projects.title: Autonomous ROV Navigation and Localization (Thesis)
projects.description:
- Developing a method of localizing and navigating an autonomous underwater vehicle in open water without the use of beacons
- Researching current solutions and attempts of navigation and localization
- Designing a system to localize itself using simultaneous localization and mapping
- Using the Cal Poly pier as the target test environment

projects.title: Autonomous Presenter Tracker
projects.description:
- Programmed a dual-core ARM Cortex A9 processor and an FPGA to track a presenter for automated recording
- Utilized RTOS to compute the location of a sound source using triangulation and to point the camera at the source
